#### `stc.relics.nixHousekeeping.deprioritiseBuilds`

Let builds and garbage collection yield to the services the machine
runs:

- the Nix daemon, and so every build, runs with CPU policy `batch`
  and IO class `best-effort` at its lowest priority (7). Not `idle`:
  upstream warns that `idle` can starve a configuration update on a
  loaded machine, which on a server is the rebuild you need;
- the daemon gets `OOMScoreAdjust=250`, so under memory pressure the
  kernel kills a build before a served process;
- the scheduled GC runs with CPU policy `batch` and IO class `idle`.

- **Type:** boolean
- **Default:** `true`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix)

#### `stc.relics.nixHousekeeping.enable`

Whether to enable bounded Nix store and journal for a long-lived host.

- **Type:** boolean
- **Default:** `false`
- **Example:** `true`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix)

#### `stc.relics.nixHousekeeping.gc.dates`

When to run the GC (systemd calendar expression).

- **Type:** string
- **Default:** `"weekly"`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix)

#### `stc.relics.nixHousekeeping.gc.enable`

Run Nix garbage collection on a timer (`nix.gc.automatic`).

- **Type:** boolean
- **Default:** `true`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix)

#### `stc.relics.nixHousekeeping.gc.keepDays`

Delete store paths, and the generations that hold them, older than
this many days. 30 days is a server's rollback window; a throwaway VM
can afford less.

- **Type:** unsigned integer, meaning >=0
- **Default:** `30`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix)

#### `stc.relics.nixHousekeeping.journal.maxRetentionSec`

journald `MaxRetentionSec`. `null` leaves journald's own (no time limit).

- **Type:** null or string
- **Default:** `"1month"`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix)

#### `stc.relics.nixHousekeeping.journal.systemMaxUse`

journald `SystemMaxUse`. `null` leaves journald's own (10% of the filesystem, up to 4G).

- **Type:** null or string
- **Default:** `"500M"`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix)

#### `stc.relics.nixHousekeeping.maxFreeGiB`

How much free space, in GiB, a build-time collection stops at
(`nix.settings.max-free`). Must be above `minFreeGiB`. Ignored when
`minFreeGiB` is `null`.

- **Type:** positive integer, meaning >0
- **Default:** `15`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix)

#### `stc.relics.nixHousekeeping.minFreeGiB`

When free space on the store drops below this many GiB during a build,
Nix collects garbage until `maxFreeGiB` is free (`nix.settings.min-free`).
`null` leaves both settings to Nix, which never collects during a build.

- **Type:** null or (positive integer, meaning >0)
- **Default:** `5`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix)

#### `stc.relics.nixHousekeeping.optimise`

Deduplicate the store on a timer (`nix.optimise.automatic`). Upstream
already runs it at idle CPU and IO priority. Skipped in a container,
whose store is the host's.

- **Type:** boolean
- **Default:** `true`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/nix-housekeeping.nix)
